owner_and_capability: The service Factory and the top-level services package are deleted (#2747, ADR 0053 point 8). The root (root-composition: api) composes the retained services itself: newServiceGraph (backend/api/service_graph_compose*.go) binds them in stages over the owners the root composed and the wiring it built for them (People, Presence, Timetable, Platform, Care Plan, Enrollment and Workforce wiring), newServeServiceGraph serves it and NewServiceGraphForTests builds the test graphs. Each stage takes the build so far and returns it extended; a value a later stage binds is read at call time. The root reaches Delivery's notification, outbox and PWA usage services, the live-group, supervision and emergency projections, the Observability PWA usage store and the Workforce group substitution row through their compositions (modules/delivery/compose, modules/grouplive/compose, modules/supervisiondashboard/compose, modules/workforce/compose and the new modules/emergencysnapshot/compose and observability/compose). The Timetable composition takes consumer-owned ports for the lifecycle staff, the deviation staff and the correction actor (LifecycleStaff, DeviationStaff, CorrectionPeople); the People Directory composition names the retained row stores the root hands the graph (Repositories). History: the partial cut of ADR 0050 (policy epoch 37 -> 38) removed the first 23 keys listed here.

atomic_cutover: One change, no policy epoch: the services production code moves into the root, which composes the retained services in newServiceGraph, and the package is deleted together with its policy package entry, its legacy_composition entry (services.Factory), the 69 rules that only it used (rules.stale) and the five baseline entries listed last. The two new compose packages are classified as created packages of their owners. Factory, NewFactoryWithModules, NewFactoryWithConfig and Factory.SetTenantRuntime are deleted; the serving root binds the unit of work through the graph's bindTenantRuntime and the test graphs through TestServiceGraph.SetTenantRuntime. The photo lifecycle is composed in the graph from the root's photo slot and file unlinker instead of the post-construction setter EnableStudentPhotos. Legacy violations 39 -> 34. The composition ratchet counts api.serviceGraph as a central aggregate and compares the base's services.Factory fields with it, so the moved fields stay shrink-only; measured after merging #2749 the surface goes 140 -> 139 because the setter EnableStudentPhotos is gone. Routes, status codes, error texts, tables and write owners are unchanged. Partial cut before it: epoch 37 -> 38 (ADR 0050), 23 keys, serviceFactoryCutoverPermission.
